human_review_status: pending; no human decisions recorded or invented

method.implementation: Ad hoc Python standard-library audit, independent full-question regex parsing and catalogue scope resolution; Decimal numeric inequalities; direct target assertion parsing. No prepare_data/review_dataset/scorer function is imported or called.

question_patterns.regex: What is the device allowance on (?P<subject>.+)\?
What is the monthly price of (?P<subject>.+)\?
How much would I pay each month for (?P<subject>.+)\?
Does (?P<subject>.+) cost at most (?P<quantity>\d+) USD per month\?
How much storage is included with (?P<subject>.+)\?
What is the storage quota for (?P<subject>.+)\?
How many support hours per day does (?P<subject>.+) include\?
For how many hours each day is support available on (?P<subject>.+)\?
Does (?P<subject>.+) include at least (?P<quantity>\d+) support hours per day\?

method.checked_rows: Every row in the four explicitly named pilot train/validation task files. Pilot catalogue/manifest/derivation metadata are read; original/test/challenge datasets and review registries are not read.
method.temporal_rule: Half-open effective interval; effective_from <= as_of < effective_to, or no end.
method.scope_rule: Question parsed entity, property, plan and version all equal correction scope, and effective interval contains as_of.
method.comparison_rule: price_monthly: corrected price <= requested budget; devices/storage/support: requested quantity <= corrected limit.
method.limitation: Machine parsing assesses the controlled templates and stated limit semantics, not arbitrary language or human comprehension.
